subject: Adopter exception request: BrightPay migration runway and comms
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Adopter exception request: BrightPay migration runway and comms

Team —

Quick background: BrightPay (our largest payroll customer in EU) requested an extra six-week runway to migrate off the legacy /v1/chat endpoint to the new model family. They cited audit timing and a pending vendor attestation that blocks their ability to accept the new token format until mid-Oct.

Why this is urgent: DP-4921 is in late-stage contract renewal and the customer will likely push expansion if we can offer a formal, timeboxed exception (not indefinite). Legal asked for an internal signoff and a brief comms plan before we commit on the renewal cadence.

Ask: can infra/product approve a limited exception window (45 days starting 2028-09-15) with specific guardrails:
- explicit read-only routing for sensitive endpoints during the window (no new feature flags),
- telemetry tag so we can measure requests routed under the exception,
- automatic expiry unless extended via leadership Slack + ticket.

I've attached a proposed calendar and a filled adopter-exception form from the customer.

Please reply with:
1) technical feasibility + any risks we should enumerate (Aditya)
2) suggested comms text and gating language Legal/CS can use (Marissa)
3) ops ticket and rollback owner (Priyom)

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: BrightPay-Migration-Calendar-v2.xlsx, Adopter-Exception-Form.pdf

Subject: Re: Adopter exception request: BrightPay migration runway and comms

Grace —

Short answer: feasible with caveats.

What we can do quickly:
- Add a request header-based routing rule so calls with X-BrightPay-Exception: true are sent to a pinned model variant that keeps the legacy token path intact.
- Emit a metric (internal.migration.exception.brightpay) and tag every request for billing and SLA reporting.

Risks / items to note:
- Pinned variant will bypass some of the new quantization profiles; expect ~8–12% higher per-token cost for that traffic.
- Prefix caching differences: since some customers use long-prompt prefixes, we should cap allowed prefix length to protect memory; otherwise we risk eviction storms.
- Security review: routing by header needs a short-lived token approach on the customer side to avoid header spoofing; recommend we require signed header via HMAC or a short-lived API key tied to the exception. Security team needs to sign off.

Operational ask for Priyom: can you create a staffed rollback runbook and own the alerting thresholds for the 45-day window? I can ship the routing change the week of 9/11 if we have signoff.

- Aditya
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Adopter exception request: BrightPay migration runway and comms

Thanks — this reads actionable. A few additions from product/comms/legal perspective:

Proposed comms (short):
> Hello Anna — we can provide a timeboxed migration exception to support your audit schedule. The exception will be active from 2028-09-15 to 2028-10-30 and is subject to technical guardrails and regular telemetry checks. We will require a signed exception form and an HMAC header for validation. We will reach out to confirm the activation window 3 business days before the start date.

Key gating language for Legal:
- Exception is timeboxed and non-transferable.
- Price adjustments for legacy routing traffic are charged at the standard per-token rate; no long-term discounts for exception traffic.
- Customer must complete the attached Adopter-Exception-Form and provide a security contact for HMAC key exchange.

Comms cadence suggestion:
- 9/06: internal signoff (this thread)
- 9/08: send formal exception offer and DocuSign to customer
- 9/12: technical activation runbook complete and infra meets preflight checks
- 9/15: soft activation (monitoring only, no charges for first 48 hours)

I've updated the spreadsheet and added suggested DocuSign language. See Drive folder in links.

Marissa
Product Lead, Reliability & Customer Ops
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Anna Li <anna.li@brightpay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPay IT Security <security@brightpay.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 09:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Adopter exception request: BrightPay migration runway and comms

Grace / team —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the proposed window. We appreciate Redwood accommodating the audit timing. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) We cannot implement an HMAC header until our vendor attestation clears (target mid-Oct). Is a short-lived API key acceptable in the interim?
2) We need the ability to pause exception traffic at short notice if our auditors flag the path. Can you confirm the rollback timeline from activation?

We are OK with the timeboxed approach as long as the billing pause for the first 48 hours is honored (our procurement lead will countersign). I'll review the DocuSign and return the signed form early next week.

Best,
Anna Li
Head of Integrations, BrightPay
anna.li@brightpay.com

Status update / decision summary: thanks everyone for the fast replies.

Decisions made
- Approve 45-day timeboxed exception window: 2028-09-15 through 2028-10-30.
- Technical guardrails: header-based routing + HMAC preferred; short-lived API key accepted as interim per Anna's note. Aditya to implement routing and metric emission during week of 9/11.
- Ops & rollback: Priyom to create a runbook with a 2-hour rollback SLA and on-call owner for the exception traffic. Priyom — please attach the runbook link to the ticket and ping #infra-ops before activation.
- Billing: first 48 hours free; standard per-token pricing thereafter. Finance will reconcile via DP-4921.

Next steps (owners):
- 9/08: Marissa to send DocuSign draft to Anna (actioned).
- 9/11: Aditya to stage routing change in canary cluster and provide test checklist.
- 9/12: Priyom to finalize runbook and alert thresholds.
- 9/14: Legal signoff of final DocuSign text.
- 9/15: Soft activation (monitor only, billing paused 48 hrs).

I'll update the HubSpot deal and mark the exception in the renewal plan. If anything changes (Anna or security team), reply-all and we'll triage.

—Grace
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
